nodes.label: 2026-08-11-five-questions-matching-design.md — the five-questions matching design: a proposal for sign-off, written by the retrieval-scientist agent, that salvages the user's original five questions by asking the same five of both the query and the chunk and matching answers to answers. A line marked [MEASURED] is a quantity computed from disk on 2026-08-11 with its source; a line marked [USER] is the user's own words or his own commit, cited; everything else in the mechanism sections is agent construction and says so.

The user's concept, verbatim [USER]. The five questions are his original design, from his initial commit (dba1160, 2026-05-07, prompts/extract_chunk.md): every chunk is read by asking five questions of it and tags are the answers — 1 theme, what is this chunk about; 2 object_entity, what specific things (people, organizations, products, systems, campaigns, documents, datasets) are mentioned; 3 event_process, what kind of occurrence or process is described (decision, change, incident, launch, measurement, agreement, publication); 4 time_relevance, when is this relevant (recent, historical, future, active, completed); 5 information_need, what kind of evidence does this chunk supply (number, quote, cause, summary, comparison, status, confirmed_fact). Each tag answered exactly one question and carried one saliency weight (`cluster` — exactly one of the five; `weight_local` — float in [0,1]). He renamed the five in his own commit 48fbc9d (2026-05-11): theme→topic, object_entity→entities, event_process→activity, time_relevance→temporal, information_need→evidence — the five facet names the graph carries today (ALL_FACETS). What the current graph kept and lost: the tag strings and the five facet names survive; the one-question-per-tag assignment (cluster) does not exist on any edge.

What the salvage is. Ask the same five questions of both sides and match answers to answers. At build time (everything precomputable) each chunk's five answers are recovered from what the graph and corpus already hold; at query time the prompt is read for what it names, what action it asks about, what time it points at, what kind of evidence its form implies, and its overall topic — words and text spans, never model-emitted numbers. Each asked question scores each chunk by content agreement between the query's answer and the chunk's answer; a question the prompt does not ask contributes a constant, the same for every chunk, so it changes no ordering. Every score is a weight; nothing filters. The mechanism is agent construction on top of his concept, and unapproved.

The two prior mechanisms it must not silently repeat, and how it differs. The demand weighting (artefact_v1_relevance_weight) weighted importance scalars by a query-side facet-demand vector: [MEASURED] 94.0% of its edge score was a query-independent constant and every demand entry was positive, so an unasked facet could only be wanted 'slightly less', never nothing — the neutral-when-unasked rule and content-match (not importance) are what this design changes. The facet-scalar placements on the det leg moved nothing: [MEASURED] the baked facet factor does not separate gold-bearing from non-gold chunks (median highest factor 0.6100 vs 0.5800; whole-graph means 0.6053 vs 0.5815) and the detE/detf/detR/detA facet-channel probes moved recall ≤ +0.003 — those measured facet values as multipliers, while this design does not multiply by stored facet values at all. The ordering wall: every re-rank of the existing door values caps at ~0.79–0.80 on 10smoke and the diagnosis prescribed 'a finer within-scope relevance signal', so the wall does not bind this design in advance and does not excuse it either — any test still reports against scope-alone as the mechanism-isolating control. [MEASURED] The one lead in its favour: the 07-29 corroboration probe found tag-corroboration wins on person/company questions while description distance wins on content questions.

Build time (his precompute ruling). All query-independent and cached once, keyed like the existing caches (derived_facet_cache / tag_distance_cache pattern: entry directory named by database, run id and layer key; manifest written last as the completeness marker). Role recovery — 'role' is this doc's label for his lost cluster field, which of the five questions a tag answers: role(τ) = argmax_j fit_j(τ), hard, mirroring his one-cluster-per-tag original, with the five-slot fit array from one of three candidate sources (OPEN O3): the derived layer's tag marginal — mean over its edges of (φ_j − ½) with unevidenced cells contributing 0; the same z-scored by the corpus spread of the marginals; or the baked w_facets on the live edges. A soft variant keeps the whole normalized fit vector instead of the argmax. Answer sets per chunk: entities E(c) — the entity-role tags on c's edges with their existing embeddings, stored as a CSR index into the tag-embedding matrix; activity A(c) — same; topic — c's description embedding plus topic-role tags; temporal d(c) — c's median record day computed exactly as the derived build's temporal estimator computes it; evidence v(c) — c's 15-feature register profile and its cosine against each declared-class prototype. Extracted names and action phrases embed through the existing per-text embed cache — no new transport.

Query time. Extract from the prompt text as words and spans only (the model emits no numbers — canon): named things N(q), what the query names; action phrase a(q), what occurrence or process it asks about; time reference t(q), parsed to a day, a range (year, quarter, month) or a posture word (recent/historical/future/active/completed — his original taxonomy); evidence kind e(q) from the question's form (how much / how many → number, why → cause, did they decide / was it approved → status, compare → comparison, what happened / summarize → summary, what did X say → quote; mapping OPEN O5); and the query embedding for topic. Whether a deterministic extractor (det leg, regexes + lexicons, no model) or the interpreter (words only) does this is OPEN O6.

Per-question match functions (proposed defaults, each OPEN O4). Each asked question j gives every chunk a score m_j(q,c) ∈ [0,1]. entities: m_ent = max over n ∈ N(q), τ ∈ E(c) of (1 + cos(emb(n), emb(τ)))/2 — one small matmul per query, the few named-thing vectors against the precomputed entity-role tag matrix, then a per-chunk segment max; alternatives are mean over names, or sum with diminishing returns. activity: the same form over a(q) against A(c). topic: (1 + cos(query_emb, desc_emb(c)))/2, the existing description channel unchanged. temporal: for a point/range reference m_time = exp(−|day(c) − day(q)| / s) with s a corpus scale (e.g. the sd of chunk days), a range reference using distance-to-interval, a posture word mapping monotonically onto recency rank; a chunk with no date under an asked temporal question contributes the neutral constant or scores low — genuinely open (O4b), and the 97.3% coverage makes the choice affect only ~2.7% of chunks. evidence: the chunk's register-profile cosine against the prototype of the asked kind, rank-calibrated onto [0,1], or plain label agreement.

The neutral rule (the core of the salvage, OPEN O1): an unasked question contributes a constant κ_j across all chunks — under an additive combine equivalent to contributing nothing, under a multiplicative combine κ_j = 1. It never varies per chunk, so it cannot reorder anything, and it is what removes the 94%-shared-constant failure mode: the demand weighting gave every facet a positive per-chunk-varying weight on every query, while here a question not asked is silent. No gates: every m_j is a weight and nothing is filtered on any of them (his 07-15 ruling); chunk-side silence on an asked question contributes its floor or the neutral constant and never excludes the chunk.

The combine — parametrized, decided by no one here. score(q,c) = Combine({m_j : j asked}) with the candidate family carried as a run configuration and none of them a default: additive Σ_j w_j · m_j; multiplicative Π_j m_j^w_j (unasked ⇒ exponent 0); noisy-OR 1 − Π_j (1 − w_j·m_j), the relevance-weight arm's guide form. Which math combines the weights is canonically undecided by his own ruling, so the design carries the family and decides nothing.

Where it plugs in — DECIDED 2026-08-12: the flat combined scorer (D7). His constraint, 2026-08-11: "i mean ,the point is that the chunk descriptions and the tags are supposed to work TOGETHER to find gold.. it's a combo.." — read against the candidates, the five question-matches and the description score are one combination, so no candidate is run as a tags-only replacement for description matching, the measured failure mode of the walk. The four candidates: 1 flat scorer, score(q,c) ranking the whole chunk population directly, top-k — cheapest, cleanest to measure, no interaction with the walk; 2 inside the walk, ordering or weighting areas in the det leg's walk; 3 as guides, joining stated scope and description in the relevance-weight arm's noisy-OR guide stage; 4 as the tag-door value on the det leg, noting the det tag door currently touches ~1 chunk/question. Stated scope stays what it is — the hard-field match is not one of the five questions and this design does not touch it.

Feasibility 4a — dominant-facet recoverability [MEASURED] from the derived facet cache (67,913 edges, 19,716 tags, 4,869 chunks) and the live herb-eval HAS_TAG edges. 'Clear' is the top1−top2 margin of the five-slot array; unevidenced cells (temporal only: 21.8% of edges) are excluded from the argmax. Derived layer per edge, on the calibrated [0,1] scale: median margin 0.1235; 57.30% of edges at margin ≥ 0.10, 75.82% ≥ 0.05, 31.03% ≥ 0.20; argmax facet topic 26.65%, activity 22.92%, evidence 21.75%, entities 19.89%, temporal 8.79%. Derived layer per tag, role = argmax of the tag's marginal: raw marginal gives topic 3,979 (20.2%), entities 5,872 (29.8%), activity 5,559 (28.2%), temporal 2,006 (10.2%), evidence 2,300 (11.7%) with 60.77% at margin ≥ 0.10; z-scored by corpus spread gives 4,128 (20.9%), 3,873 (19.6%), 4,080 (20.7%), 3,927 (19.9%), 3,708 (18.8%) with 53.81% ≥ 0.5 sd. The raw reading favors the high-spread facets (entities sd 0.304, activity 0.315 vs temporal 0.096); the z-scored reading balances the five almost exactly. Baked layer: temporal present on only 3.3% of edges, entities 49.7%, 6.8% of edges carrying a single facet cell (no margin at all), 18 distinct quantized values in a 0.30–1.00 band with margins stepping in 0.05 units (p50 = 0.10) and a topic-dominated argmax (67.49%) — materially coarser than the derived layer.

One measured warning: the highest-margin entity-role tags in the derived layer are URL/PR slugs (github_com_salesforce_actiongenie_pull_37, …) — the entity answer sets inherit the vocabulary's 12.96% URL/PR population. The tag layer is his declared priority blocker (08-06 ruling), this design rides the current vocabulary unless he retags, and role quality is bounded by tag quality.

Feasibility 4b — chunk date coverage [MEASURED] over all 4,869 chunk locators resolved against the oracle-stripped corpus by the derived build's own reader, read-only, plus the tag strings from the facets.npz edge list. 4,737 / 4,869 chunks (97.29%) carry ≥ 1 record timestamp. Per section: slack (2,669), prs (935), documents (786), meeting_transcripts (347) each 100.00%; urls (61), metadata (61: directory_batch 31, org_tree 30), meeting_chats (10) each 0.00%. Date-shaped tags (a year, month-name or quarter token, URL/PR-shaped tags excluded): 100 of 19,716 tags reaching 106 chunks (2.18%). Union of either source: 4,738 chunks (97.31%) — date-shaped tags add exactly 1 chunk over the timestamps. The temporal answer is a timestamp story, not a tag story, and the 2.7% undated remainder is exactly the urls/metadata/meeting_chats population.

Feasibility 4c — query-side extraction sanity, pseudo-queries only [MEASURED]. Source: the chunk-description probe bank, text recovered from the user's own committed tagging-run snapshot (branch v3, pilot_full_herb_snapshot_20260514T052226Z.zip, neo4j_chunks_final.jsonl), all 4,869 live-chunk descriptions present; sample n=200, seed 20260811; no questions file and no arm outputs were opened. Deterministic extraction (product lexicon from the corpus file names + capitalized/CamelCase/acronym runs; a 61-stem verb lexicon; year/quarter/month/relative regexes) finds: named things ≥1 hit 100.00% (product lexicon alone 70.50%), mean 3.62 items; action phrase 99.50%, mean 4.57; time reference 46.50%, mean 0.97 (median 0); all three at once 46.50%. Caveat stated plainly: these pseudo-queries are corpus descriptions, a richer register than HERB questions — the rates say deterministic extraction works on this domain's text, not what it yields on the real question set, which is gold-closed to this agent.

DECIDED — his rulings, quoted. D1 precompute everything query-independent: "ffs, everything that doesnt need to be ran in querytime should be premade!" (08-11 11:14, user_turns_all.md:5679) — all of the build-time section sits under this. D2 the combine is canonically undecided: "mark that down as canonically undecided because we are testing what is the best solution there" (08-04 16:33, turns:4762). D3 no hard filters; rankings, not gates: "gate? wtf? why have a gate? why not ust that as promoted guidance? … hard filter seems insane, much better to use rankings etc" (07-15 08:21, turns:729). D4 the model emits no numbers, ever — the query-side read emits words and spans only. D5 the five questions and their names are his (commits dba1160 and 48fbc9d). D6 reporting frame: baseline means lucene and vector, both artefact legs are reported and neither is the artefact number. D7 placement — the flat combined scorer and one trial run: proposed to him 08-12, his go the same day "doit and do a run to see if its te right way" (after "lets try it", 08-11); the run is a trial of the direction, never a pass-bar.

OPEN — needs his ruling before anything is built. Trial-run note (08-12): D7 orders the build and one run, and that does not rule O1 or O3–O7 — the trial uses the proposed defaults as configuration, each behind a flag and reported as configuration. O1 the neutral-when-unasked rule, agent construction and the load-bearing fix. O2 where it plugs in — DECIDED 08-12 as D7, the flat combined scorer; the walk, guide-stage and det-door placements stay unbuilt. O3 role source and hardness: derived vs baked vs a retagged tagger emitting cluster again; raw vs z-scored fit; hard argmax vs soft five-slot profile. O4 the per-question match functions: max vs mean over named things, undated-chunk handling under an asked temporal question, the temporal closeness scale, rank-calibration vs raw cosine. O5 the evidence-kind taxonomy and the question-form → kind mapping. O6 who reads the query — deterministic extractor vs the interpreter emitting words. O7 the combine's test plan: which candidates run, on what set, against which controls, presented for sign-off with hypothesis and decision rule pre-stated.

Reviewed property the multiplicative leg carries (08-12, review-confirmed): with {0,1}-valued or floored matches (evidence label mode, temporal floor on undated chunks) tier membership dominates top-k — labelled chunks outrank all others regardless of topic whenever the tier holds ≥ k, a de facto membership filter at k. No floor constant removes it; it is the multiplicative form meeting binary matches, and the non-gating alternatives (graded evidence, neutral silence) are exactly the O1/O4b configuration space. Any multiplicative leg is reported with this property named. Standing canon conflicts touched, not resolved: 'model emits no numbers' vs the interpreting leg's 0.0–1.0 facet scores, and 'the chunk description is dead' vs the topic match riding desc_emb.

Literature — published frames, kept separate from the construction, searched 2026-08-11; none is the source of the concept, and where a frame differs from his concept his concept governs. Field-aware ranking: BM25F scores a document as weighted field contributions (Robertson, Zaragoza, Taylor, CIKM 2004); neural multi-field ranking learns per-field matching then combines (Zamani et al., WSDM 2018, arXiv:1711.09174); Multi-Field Adaptive Retrieval (Li et al., ICLR 2025, arXiv:2410.20056) conditions field-weighting on the query — the published analogue of 'which questions the prompt asks'. Query decomposition / multi-condition retrieval: arXiv:2412.17558, arXiv:2606.08577, and metadata-driven RAG (arXiv:2510.24402) which routes extracted query constraints to metadata filters — exactly what D3 forbids here. Entity-aware matching: the word-entity duet (Xiong, Callan, Liu, SIGIR 2017; EDRM arXiv:1805.07591), with the entities match being the duet's query-entity-to-document-entity channel and tags as the document entities. Temporal IR: Li and Croft CIKM 2003, graded temporal relevance rather than filtering. Expected answer type: question classification into answer types (Li, Roth, COLING 2002; SMART arXiv:2012.00555), kept as words and used as a weight, never to narrow. What was NOT done: no pipeline code, no v3/ edits, no runs, no judge calls, no model calls; herb was never queried, herb-eval was read read-only, no question text and no gold was opened.
